recommendation.title: Architecture & Context Scaling (E4 Context Scaling & E5 Architecture Scaling)
recommendation.why_next: WS07 Stage B proved that repetition is eliminated via inference decoding controls and that EOS termination reaches 100% in E3-E. The remaining failure modes (context forgetting and low functional pass rate) are architectural bottlenecks that cannot be solved by data alone. The context window must expand to T=512 and parameter capacity must scale from 528k to ~3.2M parameters.
what_to_avoid: DO NOT promote any candidate to production
DO NOT attempt uncurated web scraping
DO NOT proceed to WS08 until Stage C produces a qualified scaled candidate
success_criteria: Context window scaled to T=512 tokens with verified attention mask
Architecture scaled to ~3.2M parameters (L=4, d=256, h=8)
Peak RAM remains under 1.5 GB on dual-core CPU with zero swap
Pass rate on 24 CAP probes improves to >= 25.0%
Multi-turn context retention (CAP-08 Kumar probe) passes cleanly
